items.title: Restore the build command line to the README section session-brief-prompt-sync-smoke reads and confirm the smoke passes
items.context: RED: node packages/main/dist/tasks/session-brief-prompt-sync-smoke.js on main fails with an assertion naming README.md and the missing npm --prefix packages/main run build line. GREEN: after the README edit the same command prints its final PASS line and exits 0. Place the line next to a note that a fresh build emits dist/cli.js without the exec bit until docs/story/drafts/build-emits-non-executable-cli lands.
